Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results by attributing a DuckDuckGo/Wikipedia snippet (“The conference is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia”) to the official SEC site (secsports.com) and adopted Atlanta as the HQ city without verifying on an authoritative SEC page. This led to an incorrect conclusion and subsequent repetitive instructions, despite conflicting evidence (e.g., Birmingham address) and lack of explicit confirmation from official sources.
